title: SQL AG cert-rotate: per-node replica certs
description: The nexus-cli cert-rotate verb for the Always On AG: per-node rotate of the 2 standalone replicas (each owns its own certificate); the FCI shared cert is rotated by cert-rotate sqlserver.

observe.what: sql-ag-rep-1 + sql-ag-rep-2 each get a DISTINCT new serial (standalone per-node certs); MSSQLSERVER restarts; 0 errors

whatProves: the standalone AG replicas rotate independently (distinct certs) -- unlike the FCI shared cert -- because each owns its own SuperSocketNetLib checkpoint.
